description: Image Description: A close-up view of a red apple hanging from a tree branch, with a noticeable bite taken out of its side, revealing the pale, fleshy interior. Two wasps are actively feeding on the exposed fruit; one is positioned near the top edge of the hole, while the other is deeper inside, with its wings partially spread. The apple's skin is smooth and shiny, reflecting sunlight, and it is attached to a greenish-brown tree branch that shows some lichen
